Method.name: submitSingleMessage
Method.Implementation: set status = $$$OK set pResponse= ##class(IHC.ITF.Response.submitSingleMessageResponse).%New() Set ..Adapter.WebServiceClientClass = "IHC.ITF.Service.clientPortSoap12" Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("submitSingleMessage",.resp,pRequest.username,pRequest.password,pRequest.facilityID,pRequest.hl7Message) Set tSC = pRequest.NewResponse(.pResponse) if tSC'=$$$OK { set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).FailMsgError("Out-Iris-Vxu-Wssc", "Could not get the service response...") } Set pResponse.return=$get(resp) $$$TRACE("Response Msg: "_pResponse.return) If pResponse.return["MESSAGE REJECTED"{ $$$TRACE("RESPONSE ERROR -YES") set errTxt = pResp.return set hl7Msg = pRequest.hl7Message set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).InputDataError("Out-Iris-Vxu-Wssc", errTxt_" Hl7Message --> "_hl7Msg) } Quit status
